_comment: Filling the box. Shapeless on purpose (Jonah, 2026-09-05): how you arrange tools in a toolbox is not
a thing the world should have an opinion about, only whether you have them. What is shaped is
The six are a real field kit, each mapped to something that already exists rather than to an invented
intermediate: a brush to dust a specimen, a streak plate to scratch it against, a lodestone for the
magnetic test, a diamond as the hardness reference (Mohs 10), a barrel for the samples, and deretheni
because the survey is about deretheni.
The streak plate is temperstone, which a hot Age standing in lava bakes out of its own ground -- so
the instrument that tells you what an Age holds is itself built from something only a written Age can
give you. The rime crystal that stood here goes to the crystal viewer, where a crystal is the thing
itself rather than a stand-in for a hand lens.
